[EN] Look up in the sky, my friend. Tell me we don't face a foe worthy of the gods. In our arrogance, we proclaim this the Age of Mortals. I guess now we'll find out if that's true or not.
[ES] Mira hacia el cielo, amigo mío. Dime que no enfrentamos a un enemigo digno de los dioses. En nuestra arrogancia, proclamamos esta la Age of Mortals. Supongo que ahora descubriremos si eso es verdad o no.
